title: Normalized scalar Hom maps and internal-to-section transport data
statement: Let $X$, $\Lambda$, $\Gamma$, the native and section module categories, and their evaluation-normalized Hom presentations be as in [def-sfb-internal-section-hom-comparison-data]. For a coefficient map $a$ whose ordinary scalar extension [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] is exact on every scheme, define the native scalar Hom map as the closed transpose of inverse normalized scalar tensor comparison followed by scalar-extended evaluation, using [def-sfb-internal-scalar-tensor-comparison]. Define its restricted counterpart by the five closed/scalar adjunction bijections evaluated at the identity. With section scalar models $M$ and their representative-normalized tensor comparisons $\mu$ [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data], ScalarTransport consists of ordinary restriction comparison fixing every section, its derived comparison equal to its literal localization, extension comparison compatible with actual scalar-adjunction transposes, its normalized tensor square, and equality of the actual native evaluation-transpose Hom map with the section evaluation-transpose map. These data assert no invertibility of that Hom map and impose no boundedness or continuity on its inputs. The internal coefficient map is the pulled-back ring map [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]; its section map is the actual section-ring map [def-sfb-section-scalar-map-data].
